description: Loan No./Credit No./ Grant No.: IDA-E1110 Reference No.: ET-AUC-545053-CS-INDV (CONSULTING SERVICES– Individual SELECTION) Name of Project: Africa Centres for Disease Control Support Program to Combat Current and Future Public Health Threats Project (P178633) The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC), a specialized technical institution of the African Union, is committed to ensuring a safe, secure, and healthy work environment for its staff, partners, and visitors. As part of its Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) efforts, Africa CDC aims to strengthen its preparedness and response capacity for emergencies across its Headquarters (HQ) and Regional Collaborating Centres (RCCs). In line with this commitment, and in compliance with the World Bank Environmental and Social Framework (ESF), particularly ESS2 (Labor and Working Conditions), ESS4 (Community Health and Safety), and ESS10 (Stakeholder Engagement), Africa CDC recognizes the critical importance of safeguarding personnel against a wide range of potential threats. These include, but are not limited to, physical hazards, natural disasters, public health emergencies, and security-related incidents. To address these risks, Africa CDC seeks to develop a comprehensive Emergency Response Plan (ERP) that will provide a structured and coordinated framework for emergency management. title: Membership of the Africa CDC Continental Immunization Advisory Council
description: Africa CDC invites expressions of interest from distinguished African leaders, experts, and advocates to serve as members of the Continental Immunization Advisory Council (CIAC). The CIAC is a high-level strategic advisory and action-oriented platform established to accelerate the delivery of the Africa CDC Continental Immunization Strategy 2026–2030 (CIS) and broader Continental Immunization priority issues in Africa. The CIS Strategy positions immunization as a foundational pillar of resilient, epidemic-ready primary health care, health security, equity, and sustainable development across Africa. CIAC members will serve as senior strategic advisors, advocates, and accelerators for the implementation of the Continental Immunization Strategy. Members will be expected to bring independent judgment, leadership experience, technical insight, political influence, financing expertise, community perspectives, or institutional networks that can help drive momentum in advancing immunization in Africa. Members will provide high-level strategic advice to Africa CDC on opportunities, risks, and bottlenecks affecting immunization systems; champion immunization as a priority for primary health care, health security, equity, and human capital; and support advocacy for sustainable domestic financing, partner alignment, and accountability. title: Provision of catering services within the Africa CDC HQ compound.
description: Date of Publication : 10 June 2026 Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) is a continental autonomous health agency of the African Union established to support public health initiatives of Member States and strengthen the capacity of their public health institutions to detect, prevent, control and respond quickly and effectively to disease threats. Africa CDC supports African Union Member States in providing coordinated and integrated solutions to the inadequacies in their public health infrastructure, human resource capacity, disease surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, and preparedness and response to health emergencies and disasters. The Africa CDC Headquarters in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia currently comprises of more than 200 staff members operating in a multicultural and multi-linguistic environment and seeks to provide professional and authentic top-notch continental wide catering services in-order to satisfy its staff, invited delegates and guests to meet multicultural and multi-diverse needs.
